Shell(node -e  const JSZip = require("jszip"); const fs = require("fs"); const buf = fs.readFileSync("example/Animated Syringe.lottie"); JSZip.loadAsync(buf).then(async zip => { const m = JSON.parse(await zip.file("manifest.json").async("string")); const id = m.initial?.animation; const animPath = "a/" + id + ".json"; const anim = await zip.file(animPath).async("string"); const d = JSON.parse(anim); console.log("v:", d.v); console.log("w x h:", d.w, "x", d.h); console.log("fr:", d.fr, "ip:", d.ip, "op:", d.op); console.log("layers:", d.layers?.length); console.log("nm:", d.nm); console.log("valid lottie:", typeof d.v === "string" && typeof d.fr === "number" && Array.isArray(d.layers)); }); )

Shell(node -e  const JSZip = require('jszip'); const fs = require('fs'); async function loadLottieFile(filePath) { const buf = fs.readFileSync(filePath); const zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(buf); const manifestEntry = zip.file('manifest.json'); if (!manifestEntry) throw new Error('no manifest'); const manifest = JSON.parse(await manifestEntry.async('string')); if (!manifest.animations?.length) throw new Error('no animations'); const selectedId = manifest.initial?.animation ?? manifest.animations[0].id; const animPath = 'a/' + selectedId + '.json'; const animEntry = zip.file(animPath); if (!animEntry) throw new Error('not found: ' + animPath); return JSON.parse(await animEntry.async('string')); } loadLottieFile('example/Animated Syringe.lottie').then(d => { console.log('nm:', d.nm); console.log('w x h:', d.w, 'x', d.h); console.log('valid:', typeof d.v==='string' && typeof d.fr==='number' && Array.isArray(d.layers)); }); )
